stem: Why are the stage directions at the end of Scene 3 important?

options.label: F
options.text: They tell the reader that the nightingale abandons the emperor.

options.label: G
options.text: They allow the reader to appreciate the beauty of the mechanical nightingale.

options.label: H
options.text: They help the reader visualize the comfortable surroundings the emperor enjoys.

options.label: J
options.text: They let the reader recognize the difference between the two nightingales.
